ffe5b67df7065429ca66.en: A relative clause adds information about a noun.
ffe5b67df7065429ca66.id: Relative clause menambahkan informasi tentang kata benda (noun).

9ba1b80c6dcf42c5a5fa.en: Use who for people, which for things and animals, and that for either.
9ba1b80c6dcf42c5a5fa.id: Pakai who untuk orang, which untuk benda dan hewan, dan that untuk keduanya.

508678e70d42c2c22a47.en: Use where for places, when for times and whose to show belonging.
508678e70d42c2c22a47.id: Pakai where untuk tempat, when untuk waktu, dan whose untuk menunjukkan milik.

8303edd08faf73d8cc57.en: If the clause is extra information, put commas around it.
8303edd08faf73d8cc57.id: Kalau klausa itu berisi informasi tambahan, taruh koma di kedua sisinya.

37c5dc36a323a2f7a168.en: A park is a place, so the relative pronoun is where.
37c5dc36a323a2f7a168.id: Park adalah tempat, jadi kata ganti penghubung (relative pronoun) yang dipakai adalah where.

ceae54b48bd3088da499.en: A teacher is a person, so who is correct.
ceae54b48bd3088da499.id: Teacher adalah orang, jadi who yang benar.

4b150254d96a7cf7d769.en: Who is used for people. The clause who won the race tells us which girl.
4b150254d96a7cf7d769.id: Who dipakai untuk orang. Klausa (clause) who won the race memberi tahu kita anak perempuan yang mana.

e6a5bb1cc1772ba71870.en: Which is used for things, so the bicycle which I borrowed is correct. That would also work here.
e6a5bb1cc1772ba71870.id: Which dipakai untuk benda, jadi the bicycle which I borrowed itu benar. That juga bisa dipakai di sini.

869f34952f1e6db487d3.en: That lives next door tells us more about the dog, so it is a relative clause.
869f34952f1e6db487d3.id: That lives next door memberi tahu kita lebih banyak tentang the dog, jadi itu adalah klausa relatif (relative clause).

f9daec8424d3b0c62f9f.en: This is a simple sentence with one clause.
f9daec8424d3b0c62f9f.id: Ini adalah kalimat sederhana (simple sentence) dengan satu klausa.

a0b5418546fe3704b89c.en: Where follows a place (the house), when follows a time (the day), who follows a person (the teacher) and which follows a thing (the book). Whose shows the song belongs to the singer.
a0b5418546fe3704b89c.id: Where mengikuti tempat (the house), when mengikuti waktu (the day), who mengikuti orang (the teacher), dan which mengikuti benda (the book). Whose menunjukkan bahwa the song milik the singer.

46244ad00c211566c30d.en: People take who (the baker, the pilot), things take which (the umbrella, the song) and places take where (the market, the island).
46244ad00c211566c30d.id: Orang memakai who (the baker, the pilot), benda memakai which (the umbrella, the song), dan tempat memakai where (the market, the island).

a9412ae8445987604199.en: Whose replaces his and joins the sentences: I met a boy whose father is a pilot.
a9412ae8445987604199.id: Whose menggantikan his dan menggabungkan kedua kalimat: I met a boy whose father is a pilot.

858bd79758569147bf1e.en: The clause who lives in Surabaya adds extra information about my aunt, so it needs a comma before it and a comma after it.
858bd79758569147bf1e.id: Klausa who lives in Surabaya memberi informasi tambahan tentang my aunt, jadi klausa itu perlu koma (comma) di depan dan di belakangnya.

1ba1fe0aa9c7247e0557.en: A man is a person, so the sentence should say the man who fixed our roof. Which is for things and animals.
1ba1fe0aa9c7247e0557.id: A man adalah orang, jadi kalimatnya seharusnya the man who fixed our roof. Which dipakai untuk benda dan hewan.

c3a8b55fa264f86779e5.en: The extra information is about an island, so which is used. That cannot start a clause between commas.
c3a8b55fa264f86779e5.id: Informasi tambahan itu tentang sebuah pulau (island), jadi yang dipakai adalah which. That tidak bisa memulai klausa yang diapit koma.

51478796cd20a82cd0e4.en: Without commas, who finished early tells us which pupils read quietly: only the ones who finished early. With commas, it would mean all the pupils finished early.
51478796cd20a82cd0e4.id: Tanpa koma, who finished early memberi tahu kita murid mana yang membaca dengan tenang: hanya murid yang selesai lebih awal. Dengan koma, artinya semua murid selesai lebih awal.

39b77a944fa96df4cb35.en: Who sat beside me is the relative clause. It describes the boy.
39b77a944fa96df4cb35.id: Who sat beside me adalah klausa relatif (relative clause). Klausa itu menjelaskan the boy.

8b70da2feaffcc078c7e.en: Which and that both work for things. Who is for people.
8b70da2feaffcc078c7e.id: Which dan that sama-sama bisa dipakai untuk benda. Who untuk orang.

92340b00940faf3632a1.en: Who lives next door tells us which boy.
92340b00940faf3632a1.id: Who lives next door memberi tahu kita anak laki-laki yang mana.

68e2e280e92c543bb828.en: Who is for people, which for things, whose shows ownership and where is for places.
68e2e280e92c543bb828.id: Who untuk orang, which untuk benda, whose menunjukkan kepemilikan, dan where untuk tempat.

1873eda7a4e37e1d7f91.en: The relative clause which Sekar painted goes right after the picture.
1873eda7a4e37e1d7f91.id: Klausa relatif (relative clause) which Sekar painted ditulis tepat setelah the picture.

a84dc2caafb809872ff6.en: When is used after nouns about time.
a84dc2caafb809872ff6.id: When dipakai setelah kata benda (noun) tentang waktu.

9e895ef46de326b277d9.en: Extra information goes inside commas. Needed information has no commas.
9e895ef46de326b277d9.id: Informasi tambahan ditulis di antara koma. Informasi yang diperlukan tidak memakai koma.

9f247929d054c143825c.en: Where is for places, whose shows ownership, and which is for things.
9f247929d054c143825c.id: Where untuk tempat, whose menunjukkan kepemilikan, dan which untuk benda.

7cb88e3086a995d09280.en: Whose connects the girl with the bike she owns.
7cb88e3086a995d09280.id: Whose menghubungkan the girl dengan the bike miliknya.

9edc095c4c73948288a4.en: Which is used for things when the clause is inside commas.
9edc095c4c73948288a4.id: Which dipakai untuk benda saat klausanya ada di antara koma.

07e3ae7428d8e982eebb.en: Commas show that who plays chess is extra information about the only brother.
07e3ae7428d8e982eebb.id: Koma menunjukkan bahwa who plays chess adalah informasi tambahan tentang satu-satunya saudara laki-laki itu.

c6b5ff731aadbb06de98.en: The comma is in the wrong place.
c6b5ff731aadbb06de98.id: Komanya ada di tempat yang salah.

8498fe1a8ac10d9559d6.en: That works in the sentences without commas.
8498fe1a8ac10d9559d6.id: That bisa dipakai dalam kalimat yang tidak memakai koma.

97c5b9a51c6c31ad803a.en: The clause whose dog barks all night is extra information, so it goes inside commas.
97c5b9a51c6c31ad803a.id: Klausa whose dog barks all night adalah informasi tambahan, jadi ditulis di antara koma.

aa999b26925cabf5430b.en: In which means the same as where.
aa999b26925cabf5430b.id: In which artinya sama dengan where.

b174546ba46eee67c080.en: A relative clause gives extra information about a noun. Who won the race tells us about the boy.
b174546ba46eee67c080.id: Klausa relatif (relative clause) memberi informasi tambahan tentang kata benda (noun). Who won the race memberi tahu kita tentang the boy.

52cb025bdbe3a95390cc.en: Which is used for things or animals. Who is used for people.
52cb025bdbe3a95390cc.id: Which dipakai untuk benda atau hewan. Who dipakai untuk orang.

9216997e99a3d9d95a8d.en: Whose shows that something belongs to someone. The bag belonged to the girl.
9216997e99a3d9d95a8d.id: Whose menunjukkan bahwa sesuatu adalah milik seseorang. The bag adalah milik the girl.

4a5974e44280fb9d24b3.en: Where refers to a place. The house is the place.
4a5974e44280fb9d24b3.id: Where menunjuk pada tempat. The house adalah tempatnya.

fc0cb316b69aefcaf99d.en: A relative clause adds detail, for example The dog that barked was brown tells us about the dog.
fc0cb316b69aefcaf99d.id: Klausa relatif (relative clause) menambah rincian, misalnya The dog that barked was brown memberi tahu kita tentang the dog.

c43b964e35a59cd3e70b.en: The word it is not needed because that already stands for the book. The correct sentence is The book that I read was good.
c43b964e35a59cd3e70b.id: Kata it tidak diperlukan karena that sudah menggantikan the book. Kalimat yang benar adalah The book that I read was good.

56f364113cce14e8d5a8.en: We use who for a person.
